pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, roughly polygonal dark brown regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Individual patches show sub-circular to lobed geometry with non-acute edge transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative-space network with wide junction nodes. Pathways maintain relatively high pixel thickness between patches, forming a continuous and undulating topological graph across the flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, characterized by a short, uniform fringe of dark hair against the background.
